description: This file implements the MigrationPreparer class, which manages migration data storage, component readiness, and related operations in a plugin for WPEFramework. It includes methods for reading, writing, deleting migration data, handling component readiness files, and resetting states.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for managing migration data, component readiness, and reset operations within the plugin.

methods.name: escapeSed
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for sed commands, depending on the sedType (pattern or replacement).

methods.name: storeKeys
methods.description: Reads and stores keys from the data store file into internal data structures.

methods.name: resetDatastore
methods.description: Deletes the data store file and clears internal data structures.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a list based on a delimiter.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string with a delimiter.

methods.name: isDuplicate
methods.description: Checks if a string exists in a list.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes or updates a key-value pair in the migration data store.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value associated with a key from the data store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from the data store.

methods.name: setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Adds a component name to the migration readiness file, maintaining lexicographical order and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components marked as ready for migration.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the data store and/or migration readiness file based on the reset type.
